name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: The biggest movement for Billy Doe Meats is a 52.97% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days compared to the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal dip in foot traffic intent. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and activity over the 28-day window, so organic GBP remains the sole traffic driver with 580 total actions including 43 calls, 94 direction requests, and 443 website clicks.

performance.verdict: Paid is dark; organic GBP collapsing; 5 SOW milestones overdue.

findings.text: SOW milestone 'Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live' (due Aug 31) is overdue — 0 Meta spend across all 28 days confirms ads never relaunched post-test.
SOW milestones 'Pre-Launch Gate Cleared' and 'Platform Ownership Decision' both due Aug 31 remain unresolved — blocking attribution and CRM setup for renewal.
SOW milestone 'Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1' (due Aug 14) is overdue — 0 IG reach across 45 days confirms no content has been distributed from this asset.
SOW milestone 'SEO Phase 1 Guardrails Done' (due Aug 31) is overdue — 7 search impressions and 0 search clicks over 28 days show organic search is producing nothing.
GBP actions dropped -52.97% week-over-week; last 3 full days (Sep 1–3) show 0 actions vs 33–37/day in the Aug 27–30 window — a hard stop, not a gradual fade.

suggestions.text: Unblock Meta relaunch: close funnel test, confirm UTM live, and push first campaign live — 0 spend for 28+ days is a confirmed revenue gap.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has recorded $0 spend across the entire 28-day window and all 45 series days, meaning the renewal's paid channel has never activated. The funnel test (100%-off code ihbp8pmtn8) and UTM verification must be formally closed or escalated this week — these were due Aug 31. Success is confirmed when Meta spend > $0/day and Windsor registers at least one attributed purchase within 7 days of launch. Deadline: 2026-09-11.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP zero-action drop: last 3 days show 0 actions vs 33–37/day prior — verify listing is live, not suspended or flagged.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell to 0 for Sep 1, Sep 2, and Sep 3 after averaging 33–37 actions/day in the preceding week — this is a hard stop, not a seasonal dip. Nacer or the assigned web/SEO owner should log into Google Business Profile today and confirm the listing is published, not suspended, and that no ownership or verification challenge is pending. Success is GBP actions returning to ≥20/day within 3 days of any fix applied. Re-check: 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Watch Pre-Launch Gate and Platform Ownership decisions (both Aug 31, overdue) — no paid action is defensible until these unblock attribution and CRM.
suggestions.monday_update: Both the Pre-Launch Gate Cleared and Platform Ownership Decision milestones were due Aug 31 and remain open, meaning the renewal infrastructure is not confirmed ready. No paid budget should be committed until these are resolved, as attribution through Windsor and CRM intake via GHL cannot be validated without them. Sohib should escalate to Nacer for a status call this week. Re-check and decision deadline: 2026-09-11.
